dct_title_s: Populated Place Areas (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Polygon coverage of urban areas in China with populations greater than 500,000.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, urban and regional planners, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, local and regional demographic analysis, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on land use and planning and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap, (e.g. for labelling town names on maps), to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
